jobPostingInfo.title: Lead Data Scientist
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
About the role

As Lead Data Scientist you will own the machine learning models behind our ad marketplace, from research to production.

What you will do

  • Design, train and ship ranking and bidding models that serve billions of requests a day.
  • Lead a small team of data scientists and set the modelling roadmap.
  • Work with engineering on feature pipelines in Spark and Python.

What you bring

  • 7+ years in applied machine learning, some of them leading a team.
  • Deep experience with gradient boosted trees and deep learning (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Strong SQL and Python.
